y-m-29-08.title: Umugqa wabelana nge-parabola ngamaphoyinti amangaki?
y-m-29-08.topic: Amagrafu emisebenzi ye-quadratic nemigqa: inani lamaphoyinti okuwelana nenani lika-k
y-m-29-08.goal: Hlola umbono othi 'uyasebenza ezibonelweni ezimbalwa, ngakho uhlala usebenza' ezindaweni lapho inani lishintsha khona, yenza wena izibonelo ezinamaphoyinti okuwelana angu-2, bese uchaza ngenani elincane kakhulu ukuthi kungani kunephoyinti eli-1 lokuwelana noma lingekho.
y-m-29-08.material:
Dweba i-parabola y=x² nomugqa y=2x+k endizeni efanayo yama-coordinate. k yinombolo enquma y-coordinate yephoyinti lapho umugqa uhlangana khona ne-y-axis. (y=2x+k ifundwa 'y ilingana no-2 x kwengeziwe k', futhi x²-2x ifundwa 'x ngesikwele kususwe 2 x'.) Ama-x-coordinate amaphoyinti okuwelana kwamagrafu amabili ngama-x afeza x²=2x+k, okungukuthi, x²-2x=k. Ngezansi kunethebula lamanani ka-x²-2x. Funda ithebula ngokuvundlile.
  x       | -2 | -1 |  0 |  1 |  2 |  3 |  4
  x²-2x   |  8 |  3 |  0 | -1 |  0 |  3 |  8
y-m-29-08.thinking.0: Ukukhetha lapho ukuhlola khona ukwenza okujwayelekile
y-m-29-08.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukuthi kungani inani lamaphoyinti okuwelana lishintsha
y-m-29-08.prereq.0: Igrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic y=x² nethebula lamanani ezibalo ezifana no-x²-2x (izinga lebanga lesi-3 lesikole sesibili)
y-m-29-08.prereq.1: I-x-coordinate yephoyinti lokuwelana ngu-x lapho amanani ka-y ezibalo ezimbili eba lingana khona
y-m-29-08.s.s1.prompt: Ethebuleni, uma k=3 ama-x-coordinate amaphoyinti okuwelana angu--1 no-3, futhi uma k=0 angu-0 no-2, ngakho kunamaphoyinti okuwelana angu-2 kuwo womabili amacala. UMinjun ucabanga ukuthi, 'Noma k iyiphi inombolo, umugqa y=2x+k uhlangana ne-parabola emaphoyinteni angu-2.' Iyiphi indlela engcono kakhulu yokuhlola umcabango kaMinjun?
y-m-29-08.s.s1.hint.0: Funda amanani ka-x²-2x ethebuleni kusuka kwesobunxele uye kwesokudla bese ubheka ukuthi amanani ashintsha kanjani (aqhubeka nokukhula, noma ashintsha isiqondiso).
y-m-29-08.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha amanani ambalwa ka-k, bala ukuthi mangaki ama-x ethebuleni afeza x²-2x=k, bese uqhathanisa ngokulinganiselwa ukuthi k ikuphi uma inani lishintsha.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.a: Khetha uhlole izinombolo ezimbalwa ezincane zemvelo ezingekho ethebuleni, njenge-k=1, k=2, k=5
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.a: Ukuhlola kuhle, kodwa ayikho indinganiso yokuthi ubheke ini uma ukhetha amanani. Qala uthole lapho amanani ashintsha khona ethebuleni.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.b: Khetha uhlole k eseduze lapho amanani aselithebuleni ehla bese ebuya ekhuphuka (-1 noma -2)
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.b: Uthathe njengethiphu ukuthi indawo enenani elincane kakhulu ethebuleni yilapho inani lamaphoyinti okuwelana lingashintsha khona.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.c: Zombili izibonelo bezingu-2, ngakho kwanele, futhi yamukela umbono kaMinjun njengoba unjalo
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.c: Uphikelele ngokuthi 'noma iyiphi inombolo' kusukela ezibonelweni ezimbalwa. Kungase kube nezinhlobo zika-k ezingakahlolwa.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.o.d: Hlola amanani amaningana ka-k amakhulu kuneselithebuleni, njenge-k=8, k=15, k=24
y-m-29-08.s.s1.r.d: Wenza kuphela izibonelo eziningi zohlobo olufanayo lwenani (k enkulu). Bheka ukuthi amanani ka-x²-2x ashintsha kanjani ethebuleni.
y-m-29-08.s.s1.explain: Ukwengeza izibonelo eziningi zohlobo olufanayo ngeke kuvelise isibonelo esiphikisayo. Inani lamaphoyinti okuwelana lingashintsha eduze lapho inani lika-x²-2x lincane kakhulu (-1 uma x=1 ethebuleni). Ngakho ukukhetha k eseduze nalelo nani, njenge-k=-1 noma k=-2, bese uhlola kuyisihlolo sangempela. Ake sichaze isizathu esinyathelweni sokugcina.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.prompt: Thola amanani amathathu ahlukile ka-k lapho umugqa ne-parabola kuhlangana ngqo emaphoyinteni angu-2 futhi ama-x-coordinate amaphoyinti okuwelana womabili ayizinombolo ezigcwele. Faka k nama-x-coordinate x₁ no-x₂ amaphoyinti okuwelana amabili. (x₁ no-x₂ kuyizinombolo ezigcwele kusukela ku--9 kuya ku-9.)
y-m-29-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ethebuleni, thola imigqa lapho inani elifanayo livela kabili, bese ubhala leli nani njengo-k namanani ka-x ngalesosikhathi njengo-x₁ no-x₂.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.hint.1: Faka u-k owuthole ku-x²=2x+k bese ubala ngqo ukuhlola ukuthi bobabili ama-x alungile.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.ok.c1: k, x₁, no-x₂ kuyizinombolo ezigcwele ezifanela izimo.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Yenza k, x₁, no-x₂ zibe yizinombolo ezigcwele bese wenza x₁ no-x₂ zisuke ku--9 kuya ku-9.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Ama-x-coordinate amaphoyinti okuwelana amabili ahlukile komunye nomunye.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Uma x₁ no-x₂ zifana, kunephoyinti elilodwa lokuwelana. Bhala amanani amabili ahlukile.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.fail.c3: x₁ noma x₂ ayifezi x²=2x+k. Faka ngqo bese uqhathanisa izinhlangothi zombili.
y-m-29-08.s.s2.explain: Thola imigqa ethebuleni lapho inani elifanayo livela kabili: inani 0 liku-x=0 no-2, inani 3 liku-x=-1 no-3, futhi inani 8 liku-x=-2 no-4. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, noma yiliphi ipheya lezinombolo ezigcwele elinama-x₁+x₂=2 liyasebenza (isb. x=-3 no-5 kunika k=15), futhi amaphoyinti okuwelana amabili aqhelelene ngokulinganayo kwesobunxele nakwesokudla ku-x=1. Ukushintshanisa x₁ no-x₂ kunika k efanayo, ngakho kuyisibonelo esifanayo.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.prompt: Uma k=-1 kunephoyinti eli-1 kuphela lokuwelana, futhi uma k=-2 alikho. Chaza ukuthi kungani, usebenzisa ithebula (noma isibalo).
y-m-29-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ethebuleni, thola elincane kakhulu phakathi kwamanani ka-x²-2x nokuthi livela ku-x muni.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi k=-1 no-k=-2 balingana noma bangaphansi kwalelo nani elincane kakhulu yini, bese ucabanga ukuthi kukhona yini x ofeza x²-2x=k ngalesosikhathi.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe unikeze ubufakazi bokuthi inani elincane kakhulu lika-x²-2x ngu-malini ethebuleni (noma esibalweni)?
y-m-29-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi k=-1 no-k=-2 ngamunye uphi uma uqhathaniswa nalelo nani?
y-m-29-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe usebenzise uxhumano lokuthi 'ama-x-coordinate amaphoyinti okuwelana yi-x efeza x²-2x=k'?
y-m-29-08.s.s3.model.0: Inani elincane kakhulu lika-x²-2x ngu--1 uma x=1. Ngakho uma k=-1 behlangana kuphela ku-x=1, okuyiphoyinti elilodwa, futhi k=-2 incane kunalokho, ngakho alikho iphoyinti lapho behlangana khona.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.model.1: Ethebuleni, x²-2x ayikaze iwele ngaphansi kuka--1. Uma k=-1, ku-x=1 kuphela kusebenza, futhi ku-k=-2 akukho x osebenzayo, ngakho akukho phoyinti lokuhlangana.
y-m-29-08.s.s3.model.2: x²-2x=(x-1)²-1, ngakho ayikwazi ukuba ngaphansi kuka--1. Ngakho k=-1 ihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela, x=1, futhi k=-2 ayinasixazululo.

y-m-29-01.title: Yiliphi uhlelo olufanela umnawe wami kangcono?
y-m-29-01.topic: Ukusebenzisa imisebenzi emaqondana: ukuqhathanisa amaplani amabili nokusetshenziswa emngcele
y-m-29-01.goal: Veza amanani amabili akhula ngezinga elingaguquki, njengezimali, ngemisebenzi emaqondana, qonda ukuthi okushibhile kungancika ekusetshenzisweni, vuselela isinqumo sakho nokuzethemba kwakho isikhathi ngasinye lapho kufika idatha entsha, bese uklama uhlelo olusha olunelisa izimo wena.
y-m-29-01.material:
Umnawe wami ufuna ukukhetha uhlelo lwedatha yefoni. Uma ukusetshenziswa ngenyanga kungu-x GB (inombolo engu-0 noma ngaphezulu, amadesimali ayenzeka), imali yenyanga y (won) yamaplani amabili imi kanje.
Uhlelo A: imali eyisisekelo engu-3000 won + 500 won ku-1GB ngayinye, okungukuthi, y=500x+3000
Uhlelo B: imali eyisisekelo engu-6000 won + 300 won ku-1GB ngayinye, okungukuthi, y=300x+6000
(y=500x+3000 ifundwa 'y equals five hundred x plus three thousand'. Cabanga ukuthi imali ku-1GB ngayinye ayishintshi noma ukusetshenziswa kukhulu. Amanani abumbiwe.)
y-m-29-01.thinking.1: Ukubuyekeza ububanzi nokuzethemba kwesahlulelo ngedatha entsha
y-m-29-01.thinking.2: Ukuchaza umngcele lapho uhlangothi oluhle lushintsha khona
y-m-29-01.prereq.0: Incazelo yomsebenzi olayini y=ax+b: uqala ngenani eliyisisekelo b bese wengeza a njalo uma x ikhula ngo-1 (izinga leBanga 2 lesikole esiphakeme)
y-m-29-01.prereq.1: Ukubala inani lesisho ngokufaka izinombolo esikhundleni sokuhlukahluka
y-m-29-01.s.s1.prompt: Idatha ivezwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Njalo, khetha umcabango wakho mayelana nokuthi yisiphi isu esingcono.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.hint.0: Faka ukusetshenziswa okunikeziwe esinyathelweni ngasinye ezishweni ezimbili y=500x+3000 no-y=300x+6000 bese ubala izimali ngqo.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala izimali ezimbili ezibaliwe eceleni komunye kukho konke ukusetshenziswa, bese ubona ukuthi ukuthi iyiphi eshibhile kuyashintsha yini njengoba ukusetshenziswa kukhula.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Njengamanje kwaziwa kuphela izisho zamasu amabili. Awukazi ukuthi udadewenu noma umfowenu usebenzisa idatha engakanani ngenyanga.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yisiphi isu ongasho ukuthi sifanelana kangcono nodadewenu noma umfowenu?
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.after: U-A unenkokhelo eyisisekelo ephansi futhi inkokhelo ephezulu nge-1GB, futhi u-B uphambene. Uma kuhlangana kanjena, uhlangothi oluhle lungahluka uma ukusetshenziswa kuncane nalapho kukhulu. Njengoba ungakazi ukusetshenziswa okwamanje, kunzima ukunquma.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: U-A, onenkokhelo eyisisekelo eshibhile, ushibhile kuzo zonke izimo noma ngabe ukusetshenziswa kungakanani
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uqhathanise kuphela inkokhelo eyisisekelo. Bala ngqo ukuthi izimali ezimbili ziyini uma ukusetshenziswa kukhulu kakhulu.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: U-B, onenkokhelo eshibhile nge-1GB, ushibhile kuzo zonke izimo noma ngabe ukusetshenziswa kungakanani
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uqhathanise kuphela inkokhelo nge-1GB. Bala izimali ezimbili uma ukusetshenziswa kuseduze no-0GB.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kungahluka kuye ngokusetshenziswa, ngakho ngingakwazi ukunquma kuphela ngemva kokwazi ukusetshenziswa
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lo ngumcabango waqaphela ukuthi inkokhelo eyisisekelo nenkokhelo nge-1GB kuhlangene. Ukuthi uhlangothi oluhle lushintsha ngokusetshenziswa okuthile kuba ngumbuzo olandelayo.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ekugcineni izimali ezimbili ziba inani elifanayo, ngakho akukho mehluko noma ngabe ukhetha kuphi
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ngisho noma likhona ilevu lokusetshenziswa lapho zilingana, kokunye ukusetshenziswa kunomehluko. Bala izimali ezimbili ngokusetshenziswa okuningana.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Ukusetshenziswa kwemizuzu yodadewenu noma umfowenu ezinyangeni ezi-3 ezedlule kwakungu-8GB, 10GB, no-12GB. Ukubala izimali, u-A ungu-7000 won, 8000 won, no-9000 won, futhi u-B ungu-8400 won, 9000 won, no-9600 won.

y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: U-B, onenkokhelo eshibhile nge-1GB, ungcono. Intengo yeyunithi ibaluleke kakhulu kuneziphumo zokubala zezinyanga ezintathu
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ezibalweni zangempela zezinyanga zonke ezintathu, u-A wayeshibhile. Hlola ukuthi uzibeke eceleni yini iziphumo zokubala ngokubheka kuphela intengo yeyunithi.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ngiqinisekile ukuthi u-A ushibhile noma ukusetshenziswa kuba kungakanani esikhathini esizayo
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Awubalanga icala lokusebenzisa okuningi kakhulu kuno-12GB. Qhathanisa izimali ezimbili ku-30GB.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ukusetshenziswa kwezinyanga ezintathu kuyafana, ngakho angikwazi ukusho lutho ngokuthi yimuphi ongcono
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ebubanzini obungu-8 kuya ku-12GB, u-A wahlala eshibhile. Uma ukusho ngobubanzi, ungenza isahlulelo.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Udadewenu noma umfowenu uthi kusukela ngenyanga ezayo uzobuka izifundo zevidiyo, ngakho ukusetshenziswa kuzoba phakathi kuka-18GB no-22GB.
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Manje ucabanga ukuthi yisiphi isu esingcono?
y-m-29-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Ku-18 kuya ku-22 GB, u-B ushibhile. Isahlulelo sangaphambilini sokuthi u-A ushibhile ku-8 kuya ku-12 GB sasingalungile; sasilungile kuphela kulobo bubanzi. Njengoba kufika ulwazi olusha, ububanzi lapho isahlulelo sisebenza khona bashintshile.

y-m-29-01.s.s2.o.a: 15 GB: uma usebenzisa ngaphansi kwalokhu, u-A ushibhile; uma usebenzisa okuningi, u-B ushibhile

U-A, onenkokhelo eyisisekelo ephansi, ungcono ekuqaleni, kodwa njengoba inkokhelo yakhe nge-1GB iphezulu, igebe liyancipha njengoba ukusetshenziswa kukhula bese kuphenduka ku-15GB.
y-m-29-01.s.s3.prompt: Klama isu elisha C lapho udadewenu noma umfowenu esebenzisa u-18GB kuya ku-22GB. Inkokhelo ye-C ngu-y=(inkokhelo nge-1GB)×x+(inkokhelo eyisisekelo). Imibandela: inkokhelo eyisisekelo ingu-2000 won noma ngaphezulu (ngamayunithi ayi-100 won), futhi inkokhelo nge-1GB ingu-200 won noma ngaphezulu (ngamayunithi angu-50 won). y-m-29-03.title: Igrafu ye-(x-2)² ihanjiswe ngaluphi uhlangothi?
y-m-29-03.topic: Amagrafu emisebenzi ye-quadratic: isiqondiso sokuhanjiswa ku-y=a(x-p)²+q
y-m-29-03.goal: Hlola ukuthi isiqondiso sokunyakaza esinqunywe kuphela yisimo sesisho sihambisana namanani asethebuleni yini, wahlulele isiqondiso sokunyakaza ngokufanisa izindawo lapho amanani alingana khona, bese usebenzisa lowo mthetho kusisho esisha.
y-m-29-03.material:
UHaeun ukhulume ngokuthi igrafu ye-y=(x-2)² ihanjiswe ngaluphi uhlangothi kusuka kugrafu ye-y=x². 'Esishweni, u-2 ukhishwe ku-x, ngakho x yehle ngo-2. Ngakho yigrafu ehanjiswe ngakwesobunxele ngo-2.' (y=(x-2)² ifundwa 'y alingana nokuvula izibaki x kususwa ezimbili vala izibaki squared'. Ukuhanjiswa kusho ukuthi lonke igrafu lihamba ligcina isimo salo. Isobunxele yisiqondiso lapho x iba mncane, futhi isokudla yisiqondiso lapho x iba nkulu.) UHaeun wenze ithebula ngokufaka izinombolo ku-x ukuthola u-y. Funda ithebula ngokuvundlile.

y-m-29-06.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala emshweni owodwa 'ukuthi inani lika-a, uma likhula, lenza ububanzi bube kanjani', bese uhlola ngezinombolo zesibonelo.
y-m-29-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe incazelo yami ifaka icala lapho a inegethivu?
y-m-29-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngigcine inqubo yokuthi ububanzi abuyona 'indlela yokuvuleka' kodwa 'ibanga lesobunxele-nesokudla ngokuphakama okufanayo'?

y-m-29-06.s.s3.model.1: Uphawu lushintsha kuphela ukuthi ivuleka phezulu noma phansi. Ngobubanzi, shiya uphawu bese ubheka usayizi wenombolo. y=-2x² no-y=2x² banesimo esifanayo futhi bahluke kuphela ngendlela yokuvuleka. Lapho inombolo ikhulu, kuncane.

y-m-29-07.topic: Ifomu elijwayelekile lomsebenzi we-quadratic y=a(x-p)²+q: imibandela enikezwa yi-vertex nephoyinti elidlulayo
y-m-29-07.goal: Humusha imibandela eminingana ibe yizibalo ngokunembile (uhlola amaphutha), yenza imisebenzi ehlukile ye-quadratic ehlangabezana nayo yonke imibandela wena, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani kwamanye amacala kungekho sixazululo.
y-m-29-07.material: Emsebenzini we-quadratic y=a(x-p)²+q, ama-coordinate we-vertex angu-(p, q). (y=a(x-p)²+q ifundwa 'y ilingana no-a bakaki ovulekile x kususwe p bakaki ovaliwe ngesikwele kwengeziwe q'.) Ufuna ukuthola umsebenzi we-quadratic ofeza yonke imibandela elandelayo. 가) Uyakhukhumala phansi (a iyiphozithivu). 나) I-vertex ise-quadrant yokuqala (p>0, q>0). 다) Igrafu idlula iphoyinti (0, 7). a, p, no-q kuyizinombolo ezigcwele. Qala, ake sihlole ukuthi uJihun uyiguqule kanjani imibandela ibe yizibalo.
